label: label: current-main baseline (not historical)
order: HC4 §6.3 — new baseline of current main
enforcement: none. This file records measurements only; no threshold is applied or implied. GS1 owns thresholds.

recipe.context: viewport 390x844, isMobile, hasTouch, dpr 2, service workers blocked (same as play_perf_gate)
recipe.frame: a requestAnimationFrame callback actually invoked (rAF wrapped before first page script)
recipe.median: middle value of the measured runs; mean of the two middles when even; unresponsive/failed runs excluded and counted
recipe.unresponsive: a route whose page cannot answer an in-page stage within 30000 ms is recorded as unresponsive for that run and the sweep moves on

self_test.what: one scratch route measured real -> planted (four idle rAF chains instead of one) -> restored; idle_raf over 3000 ms
self_test.note: the harness reported the planted idle re-arm as a higher idle_raf count
